issues: Frontend hard-codes the download filename to 'leaderboard.csv' (or 'leaderboard_COHORT.csv') in LeaderboardPage.tsx:53, overriding the backend's nicer date-stamped 'leaderboard_YYYYMMDD.csv' Content-Disposition. Minor — works fine but loses the date suffix the backend already provides. Could simply omit the explicit `download` attribute or read it from the response header.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/ai_quiz_service.py:51 — `avoid_topics: Optional[List[str]] = None` references `Optional` but the module only imports `List` from typing. Works at runtime only because `from __future__ import annotations` defers evaluation. Recommend adding `from typing import List, Optional` for clarity and to avoid silent breakage if __future__ annotations is ever removed.

backend/routers/iter8.py:137 audit_digest — when `rows` is empty the deterministic summary ends with 'no admin activity to summarise.' and skips the LLM call entirely. That's correct, but the punctuation produces ' . no admin activity to summarise.' with a leading space when by_action is empty. Cosmetic.

backend/routers/iter8.py:181 — when LLM call fails, the fallback string appends ' (AI summary unavailable: <ExceptionName>)' to the deterministic summary. This leaks the exception class name to the UI. Consider logging instead of leaking the type name to admin users (low priority).

frontend/src/pages/dashboard/LeaderboardPage.tsx:53 — the frontend overrides the backend's date-stamped filename. Either trust the Content-Disposition header (drop the `a.download` value or set it from the header) or align with the backend's date suffix.

frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ExamsPage.tsx — after AI quiz generates, the form fields (course/numq/type) are replaced by the review state. To test multiple modes back-to-back the user must click 'Generate more' to return to the form. Works as designed; no bug.
backend/routers/exams.py:181 — AIQuizRequest.question_type uses Literal[...] which correctly rejects bad values with 422 — addresses the mode-validation feedback from iter10. Nice.
